dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-26
dates.summary:
**Bot traffic just crossed the human line**, and **Cloudflare** says the old ad-funded web may not survive the agent era; **Anthropic** plugged **Claude** into Apple’s Foundation Models stack, pushing a clean on-device-to-cloud handoff; on X, the mood swung from **Codex spreading beyond engineers** and travel-booking agent demos to a louder fight over AI regulation, identity checks, and who gets to control frontier models.

**机器人流量已经压过真人**，**Cloudflare** 直接把话挑明了：靠广告养活互联网这套，碰上 agent 可能真要改写；**Anthropic** 把 **Claude** 接进苹果 Foundation Models，端侧先跑、复杂任务再上云，这条产品线很实在；X 上也挺热闹，一边是 **Codex** 往工程圈外扩、一边是拿它去比价订日本行程，另一边则是 AI 监管、身份验证、前沿模型控制权吵得更凶了。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-25
dates.summary:
**Agents step out of chat and into the org chart**: **Aaron Levie** frames **Claude** as a shared coworker with its own permissions; **Infrastructure nerves are showing**: **Swyx** says software factories will force a rebuild of huge chunks of the stack; **Speed wars keep escalating**: **Guillermo Rauch** pushes fast **GLM** and big **AI Gateway** recovery numbers; **The biggest argument of the day** comes from **Edwin Chen** on **AI & I**: if scaling keeps holding, the real question is not capability but what humans still choose to do.

**Agent 不只是聊天框里的助手，已经在往“同事”这个位置挤**：**Aaron Levie** 讲的是有权限边界的 **Claude** 协作模式；**基础设施焦虑也摆上台面了**：**Swyx** 直接说软件工厂时代会逼着大家重建一大截底层；**速度战还在加码**：**Guillermo Rauch** 连发 **GLM** 和 **AI Gateway** 的成绩；今天最硬的一条，还是 **AI & I** 里 **Edwin Chen** 那句判断：要是 scaling law 继续生效，接下来卡人的不是能力，而是人还想不想自己动手。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-24
dates.summary:
**Claude Tag** turns Slack into an agent operating system; **Karpathy** calls it the third big LLM UI shift, and Anthropic staff say it already writes code, merges PRs, and keeps its own thread memory; **Codex**, **Vercel**, **Replit**, and **Shopify** builders all push the same direction: software is getting more headless, more multiplayer, and more native to agents; pricing pressure is getting real as **GLM** gets victory laps, **Box** argues the applied layer wins, and founders fight over where value actually lands; the wild card comes from biology, where **Biohub** pitches open-source tooling plus frontier AI as a serious path from scientific discovery toward engineering.

**Claude Tag** 今天最抢眼，Slack 里直接长出一个能干活的代理位；**Karpathy** 说这像是大模型交互的第三次改版，Anthropic 自己的人则把话说得更直白: 会写代码、会开线程、还会自己盯进度；另一边，**Codex**、**Vercel**、**Replit**、**Shopify** 这几路人马其实在讲同一件事，软件正越来越像给代理准备的底座，不再只服务人类点点点；价格战也开始有火药味了，**GLM** 被高调点名，**Box** 押注应用层，大家争的不是热闹，是价值最后落在哪一层；最出圈的反而不是纯软件，**Biohub** 把开放工具、前沿 AI 和生物学硬绑在一起，这个路数不花哨，但很硬。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-23
dates.summary:
**Security and agent tooling stole the spotlight**; **OpenAI pushed GPT-5.5-Cyber, Codex Security, and Patch The Planet** while builders kept circling one question: how do you actually work with long-horizon coding agents day to day?; **Vercel landed two sharp moves** with Claude Design deployment and WebSocket support; **Box made HTML a first-class artifact** and Aaron Levie argued evals are the real control plane for enterprise AI.; Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex kept showing up in the trenches; the mood was less "wow, cool demo" and more "show me the workflow, the infra math, and the production path."

**安全和代码智能体今天最抢戏**；**OpenAI 一口气推了 GPT-5.5-Cyber、Codex Security 和 Patch The Planet**，讨论点也很直接：长时程 coding agent 到底该怎么真用起来；**Vercel 连出两招**，一边把 Claude Design 一键发到线上，一边补上 WebSocket；**Box 把 HTML 当成正式内容来管**，Aaron Levie 也把话挑明了，企业做 AI，最后拼的就是 evals。; Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 这几个名字反复出现；气氛已经不是看 demo 图个新鲜，而是盯着工作流、算力账和能不能上线。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-22
dates.summary:
**Agents are swallowing the stack**; **Google's Gemini play is shifting from model to harness**, with Logan Kilpatrick describing an "Antigravity" layer meant to power coding, search, and consumer agents alike; builders across X keep circling the same pressure point: context beats prompts, routing beats monoliths, and headless software may become the real enterprise battleground.

**The builder feed had bite today**; **Vercel and Cursor people obsessed over craft and performance**, OpenAI folks asked where Codex still feels rough, and several investors and operators zeroed in on the strange new economics of token plans, personal context, and agents that may soon touch more data in a query than a human does in a month.

**今天最硬的线索还是 agent 在吞整条工具链**；**Logan Kilpatrick 说得很直白，Google 不只想卖模型，还想把 agent 的那层“harness”铺进编码、搜索和 Gemini 产品里**；X 上一圈人也在往同一个点上收：上下文比提示词更要命，路由层开始冒头，软件一旦变成“给 agent 用”，企业侧的玩法就要重写。

**这波动态也不只是空喊概念**；**Vercel、Cursor 这帮人盯的是手感、性能、完成度**，OpenAI 在追问 Codex 哪儿还不顺手；另一边，投资人和产品人已经在聊更现实的事：token 到底该怎么花，个人上下文值不值钱，agent 一次任务可能会翻的数据，真能比人一个月摸过的还多。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-21
dates.summary:
**Coding agents are stretching their legs**; **Anthropic** spent a full postmortem on why **Claude Code** felt worse and how three product-layer changes broke quality; managed agents are getting real enterprise plumbing with self-hosted sandboxes and **MCP** tunnels; on X, builders are split between open-weight optimism, brutal cost math, and fresh excitement around **GLM-5.2** and **Codex**.

**长程编码代理开始真上强度了**；**Anthropic** 罕见摊开讲清 **Claude Code** 最近到底坏在哪，锅不在 API，在产品层三处改动；托管代理也开始接上企业真需求，自托管沙箱和 **MCP** 隧道直接把安全边界拉回内网；X 上这波更有意思，一边在算订阅和推理成本，一边有人被 **GLM-5.2** 的代码能力吓到，还有人已经在等 **Codex** 把前端再往前推一大截。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-20
dates.summary:
**Codex chatter got loud**; builders are openly switching tools, praising browser/computer-use workflows, and pushing remote/local handoff as the next friction kill; **Anthropic went deep on containment**, arguing agent safety is now mostly a blast-radius problem, not a permission-popup problem; Intel CEO **Lip-Bu Tan** sketched a comeback plan built on CPUs for agentic workloads, a cleaner product line, and a tougher foundry play; the rest of the feed felt unusually human: boardroom honesty, conference afterglow, medical-scan arguments, and one very blunt reminder that agency, taste, and distribution still matter.

**Codex 这波声量起来了**；不少 builder 直接聊起换工具，重点全落在浏览器、computer use，还有远程/本地接力这些真能省事的能力上；**Anthropic** 那篇安全文不绕，核心就一句：权限越来越大，得先把爆炸半径关进笼子里；**陈立武** 在播客里讲 Intel，也不是空话，CPU、产品线、代工业务，全都往执行层面压；剩下几条也挺有意思，董事会该先摊最难看的那页，扫描该不该多做，VibeCon 余温还在，还有人把 AI 时代的分水岭压缩成三个词：agency、taste、distribution。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-19
dates.summary:
**Claude Code Artifacts** turns agent sessions into live internal pages; **Lambda** says AI compute is still underbuilt, with land and power, not GPUs alone, setting the pace; open weights and possible review-heavy regulation are suddenly front-and-center; builders keep shipping anyway, from SEO experiments to interactive decks and team-facing prototypes.

**Claude Code 的 Artifacts** 把代理会话直接做成团队能看的活页面；**Lambda** 那边的判断也很直白，算力没到过剩，真正卡住节奏的是土地、电力和机房；开源权重能不能追上前沿、监管会不会把模型更新拖慢，这两件事已经摆上桌面；另一边做站、做 deck、做原型的人没空空谈，先把东西发出来再说。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-18
dates.summary:
**GitHub says AI code is exploding** with 17M agent PRs in a month and 14B commits on the horizon; **Claude Design** hits paid plans and starts syncing with **Claude Code**, pushing design and shipping closer together; **OpenAI Codex** drops a surprise double reset while **Sam Altman** celebrates Noam joining after a 10-year wait; the sharper argument underneath it all is about taste, workflow depth, and whether AI is building real products or just generating faster noise.

**GitHub 把数字摊开了**：单月 1700 万个 agent PR，14B commit 的年化节奏，代码洪水已经真来了；**Claude Design** 开测，还能和 **Claude Code** 双向联动，设计和交付开始拧在一起；**Codex** 突然送双倍重置，**Sam Altman** 连发两条欢迎 Noam，牌桌上的人还在继续换位；另一边吵得也挺实在：品味怎么练，工作流的护城河到底有没有，AI 做出来的到底是产品，还是一堆勉强能跑的壳子。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-17
dates.summary:
**Codex** turbulence flipped to expansion in a day, with Europe rollout and rate-limit resets; **Cursor** kept sucking up the oxygen as operators argued the real asset is the agent harness, GTM, and the first real applied-AI mega-win; **Anthropic** plugged **Claude** into Apple’s **Foundation Models** stack while **Vercel** pushed 24-hour sandboxes and longer function runs.

**Codex** 这边先是容量报错，转头又在欧洲放功能、调额度，节奏很急； **Cursor** 继续霸屏，大家盯着的不只是交易本身，而是那套 agent harness、分发能力，还有应用层第一次真正跑出大结果的模板； **Anthropic** 把 **Claude** 接进 Apple 的 **Foundation Models**，另一边 **Vercel** 直接把沙箱寿命和函数时长一起往上抬。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-16
dates.summary:
**Anthropic** pushes managed agents into self-editing mode with dreaming and multiagent orchestration; **OpenAI** researcher **Dan Roberts** says reinforcement learning plus test-time compute is turning models into engines for scientific discovery; **Vercel**, **Replit**, and **Google** all ship harder toward agentic products, longer runtimes, specialist agents, and 70+ language voice input; meanwhile builders on X keep the tone volatile, mixing tool obsession, regulation fights, and a lot of very online product takes.

**Anthropic**把托管代理往前推了一截，dreaming、outcomes、多代理编排一口气放出来；**OpenAI** 的 **Dan Roberts** 讲得很直，RL 加测试时算力，已经开始摸到“模型自己做发现”这件事；产品层面也没闲着，**Vercel** 拉长函数运行时，**Replit** 继续押注垂类代理，**Google** 把语音输入扩到 70 多种语言；X 上还是那个熟悉的 builder 气味，一边晒爽点，一边吵开源、监管，还有人已经从 VC 往一线跑了。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-15
dates.summary:
**Agents moved from demo to operating model**; **Jensen Huang** framed AI factories as the new generators of real-time intelligence, while builders on X argued that subagents, goals, and long-running workflows are where the real leverage is; enterprise voices pushed a harder line on learning loops, proprietary knowledge, and who controls the stack; open source kept surfacing as the hedge when model access feels shaky.

**这波讨论不空了，开始落到怎么干活**；**黄仁勋**把 AI factory 讲成“生产智能”的基础设施，不只是卖卡那套话；X 上一群人聊得更具体，subagents、goal、自我拆任务、长链路 agent workflow，这些开始像真工具，不像概念片；另一条线也很直白，企业想吃到 AI 红利，得先把自家知识和数据攥在手里，开源因此又被抬回桌面。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-14
dates.summary:
**Codex** suddenly became a character in the feed, from OpenAI intros to agents signing themselves up for web services; **AI regulation** moved from abstract debate to model-release choke points, with **Fable**, jailbreaks, and export controls pulling founders into open argument; builders also kept posting the ground truth, security glitches, conference data storytelling, and a blunt reminder that taste, traction, and actual product usage still beat theater.

**Codex** 这下不只是工具，直接成了时间线里的角色，从 **OpenAI** 员工玩 AMA，到 agent 自己跑去注册服务；**AI 监管** 也不再是空话，**Fable**、越狱测试、出口管制把讨论拽到模型发布这一层，吵得很实；另一边的 feed 也挺真实，安全漏洞、会务数据、品味文章、VC 群聊风向都在提醒一件事：真产品、真使用、真判断，比表演有用。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-13
dates.summary:
**Agent infrastructure is getting real**: Anthropic split the “brain” from the “hands,” opened self-hosted sandboxes, and admitted Claude Code quality regressions came from product-layer changes, not the API; **AI policy heat spiked**: builders reacted to Fable access restrictions and the possibility that top models may soon require identity checks; **Code workflow is under attack**: swyx questioned Git itself, Vercel shipped **HarnessAgent**, and more builders described agents moving from autocomplete to full workflow operators; **The vibe was loud and personal**: founders pushed face-first distribution, complained about brutal attention scarcity, and cheered SpaceX as the week’s dominant non-AI flex.

**Agent 基建开始上硬菜了**：Anthropic 把 agent 的“脑子”和“手”拆开，自托管 sandbox 和 MCP tunnel 直接端上来；Claude Code 口碑下滑也查清了，锅在产品层改动，不在 API；**监管味道一下重了**：Fable 访问限制把圈里人炸醒了，连“顶级模型以后要不要实名”都被摆到台面上；**写代码这套老流程也被公开质疑**：swyx 开始怀疑 Git 该不该一起进博物馆，Vercel 发了 **HarnessAgent**，越来越多人已经把 agent 当执行层，不只是补全工具；**这一波内容也很有人味**：有人吐槽注意力战场卷到离谱，有人强调创始人必须亲自出镜，还有一堆人顺手把 **SpaceX** 当成这几天最硬的现实世界参照物。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-12
dates.summary:
**Google’s agent era is getting a real control layer**; **Anthropic says containment, not just alignment, is what makes powerful agents shippable**; OpenAI’s Codex orbit keeps pulling talent in, while builders on X keep arguing about the last mile: closed-loop tooling, safer autonomy, and whether current agent stacks are actually pleasant to use.

**Google 把 agent 这事往“控制层”上推了一步**；**Anthropic 明说了，光靠模型听话不够，真要上线还得把爆炸半径卡死**；另一边，OpenAI 的 Codex 继续吸人，X 上的 builder 们也没闲着，讨论点很实在：闭环工具到底谁来做，自动化怎么别翻车，现在这批 agent 到底有没有顺手到能天天用。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-11
dates.summary:
**Fable** stole the frame: builders kept posting that bigger models are changing how they work, from overnight coding loops to full video production without touching an editor; **Gemini** briefly went down, then came back, a reminder that the stack is getting more powerful and more fragile at once; product signals were everywhere: **Codex** token usage spiked, **Project Genie** expanded, and **Claude Platform** shipped scheduled deployments plus vault-backed env vars; the sharpest takeaway is practical, not philosophical: start with the strongest model, delegate longer horizons, and only optimize down once the magic is real.

今天最抢眼的还是 **Fable**：一堆 builder 都在晒，模型一变强，工作方式也跟着变了，从通宵跑代码到整支发布视频都让它自己剪，连视频编辑器都没碰；**Gemini** 先宕了一下又恢复，挺直接地提醒人一句，能力在往上冲，脆弱点也没少；产品面也很密：**Codex** token 用量突然拉高，**Project Genie** 扩容，**Claude Platform** 也把定时部署和 vault 环境变量放出来了；最有用的结论不玄，先拿最强模型把事情做通，再回头压成本、换小模型。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-10
dates.summary:
**Fable 5 detonated across builder Twitter**; power users called it the biggest jump since **Opus 4.5** and started talking like the model had crossed from assistant into partner; the louder second-order claim was even bigger: **software demand is about to spike**, not shrink. **Enterprise reality pushed back**; Aaron Levie hammered the integration gap between frontier models and usable company workflows; meanwhile builders traded hard-won tactics on self-verification, objective-first prompting, onboarding, and where browser automation still drags performance.

**今天的主线就一条：Fable 5 把圈子点着了**；一堆老手都在说这是自 **Opus 4.5** 之后最狠的一次跃迁，语气已经不是“工具升级”，而是模型开始像搭档；跟着冒出来的判断也很直接：**软件需求只会更猛，不会变少**。另一边，落地派没跟着上头；Aaron Levie 把企业里那道脏活累活的鸿沟讲得很明白，数据、流程、变更管理一个都躲不开；实操层面也很实在，大家在交换怎么写目标、怎么做自验证、怎么做 onboarding，以及浏览器链路到底有多拖后腿。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-09
dates.summary:
**Benchmarks just got meaner**: **FrontierCode** lands with maintainer-grade rubrics and a brutal 13.8% on FC Diamond, calling half of **SWE-Bench** “unmergeable slop”; **Apple developers get a new routing stack** as **Claude** plugs into the Foundation Models framework for heavier reasoning and tool use; the builder chatter is all about interfaces and control, from **NotebookLM** expanding beyond source files to **Codex** phone workflows, nested loops, and the stubborn reality that context still beats raw intelligence.

**基准开始下狠手了**：**FrontierCode** 这次不看会不会跑通测试，直接盯上代码能不能真进主干，连 **SWE-Bench** 都被点名一半是“合不进去的糊弄活”；**Apple** 这边也有实打实的新东西，**Claude** 接进 Foundation Models，轻任务留在端侧，复杂推理再往上接；另一条线也很热闹，大家都在聊工具怎么真正顺手，从 **NotebookLM** 往外扩检索、**Codex** 上手机桌面，到一句老实话反复被验证：模型再强，没上下文还是容易跑偏。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-08
dates.summary:
**Claude** gives managed agents memory "dreaming," outcome graders, and multiagent orchestration; **Aaron Levie** says enterprise AI is trapped in a weird loop where model progress keeps outrunning rollout plans.

**Codex** turns up the pressure with a 100-day power-user challenge; builders across X keep hammering the same idea: stop babysitting prompts and start designing loops; tokenmaxxing is giving way to token anxiety and token optimization; routing, retries, and cost-aware orchestration are starting to look like the real moat.

**Claude** 这次把 agent 的底层玩法往前拱了一截，dreaming、结果评分、多 agent 编排一起放出来；**Aaron Levie** 说得很实在，模型进展太快，企业那套 rollout 反而更容易被打断。

**Codex** 又添了一把火，100 天连续挑重度用户放大额度；X 上这波讨论也越来越集中，少纠结 prompt，多去搭 loop；token 焦虑这几周明显上来了；谁能把路由、重试、成本和效果一起压住，谁就更像下一层基础设施。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-07
dates.summary:
**Post-transformer doubt is back** as **Lucas Kaiser** says reasoning alone may still fall short on generalization; **model routing is turning into the new moat**, with **Madhu Guru** and **Aaron Levie** both arguing that evals, token costs, and task-level dispatch will decide who wins; builders are getting pulled deeper into their tools, from **Peter Yang** drowning in **Codex** threads to **Garry Tan** drawing a clearer privacy line around **Paxel**.

**后 Transformer** 的那点不服气又冒出来了：**Lucas Kaiser** 直说，光靠推理未必真能啃下泛化；**模型路由**也不只是工程细节了，**Madhu Guru** 和 **Aaron Levie** 都把话挑明了，评测、token 成本、任务拆分，接下来都要见真章；另一边，工具已经把人拽得更深，**Peter Yang** 嫌 **Codex** 线程快管不过来，**Garry Tan** 也顺手把 **Paxel** 的云端边界讲得更明白。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-06
dates.summary:
**Agent tooling got real teeth**; **Claude Cowork** doubled limits and pushed desktop delegation, while **Vercel** showed storage that survives sandbox lifecycles; **Replit x Shopify** and **Cursor Composer 2.5** both pointed at a simpler path from idea to shipped software; the mood across builders: prompts, memory, and workflow design now matter as much as raw model quality.

**这波更新挺实在**；**Claude Cowork** 直接把额度翻倍，摆明了要你把脏活累活丢给 agent；**Vercel** 把存储从 sandbox 生命周期里拆出来，这一下基础设施味儿就上来了；**Replit x Shopify**、**Cursor Composer 2.5** 都在推一件事：做软件的门槛还在掉，但真拉开差距的，已经不是会不会写提示词，而是你怎么组织记忆、技能和执行链路。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-05
dates.summary:
**ChatGPT** rolled out web-app publishing and a memory upgrade; **Codex** got a Python SDK while OpenAI disclosed a token undercount bug; **Anthropic** dominated the builder chatter with Claude writing most of its own code, a blunt Claude Code postmortem, and Managed Agents pushing deeper into enterprise infra; real-world evals, agent-native writing tools, and personal workflow automation kept the pressure on. 

**ChatGPT** 今天连发两下：能直接做并发布网页应用，记忆也升级了；**Codex** 一边放出 Python SDK，一边公开说修了计费少算 token 的 bug；**Anthropic** 这波声量最大，既有 Claude Code 事故复盘，也有 Managed Agents 往企业内网继续钻，还顺手放出一组很猛的内部数据，说 Claude 已经写了大部分自家代码；另一边，真实世界评测、给代理用的写作工具、个人工作流自动化，也都开始从概念往实战挪。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-04
dates.summary:
**Microsoft’s Satya Nadella frames AI as an ecosystem fight**, not a single-model race; **Anthropic gets blunt about agent blast radius**, with containment replacing endless permission prompts; **Google Labs ships Dreambeans**, a personal-intelligence app for “hope scrolling”; **Codex, Claude Code, Vercel, Figma, Cursor, OpenClaw** all show the same pressure point: agents are moving from demo magic into daily work.

**Nadella 把牌摊开了：AI 不是单模型争霸，而是生态战**；**Anthropic 这篇安全文很硬，重点不是多弹几个确认框，而是把 Claude 关进合适的笼子**；**Google Labs 推 Dreambeans，想把刷信息流改成“有点盼头的每日投喂”**；**Codex、Claude Code、Vercel、Figma、Cursor、OpenClaw 的消息挤在一起，信号很清楚：Agent 正在从演示台钻进日常工作流。**

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-03
dates.summary:
**AI agents eat the work stack**: Codex expands from devs into knowledge work, Claude Code adds workflows, Gemini exposes Thinking Levels; **yes-code vs no-code** becomes the new platform fight as Vercel, Replit, OpenClaw, and enterprise sandboxes race to make agent-built apps deployable; **Listen Labs reframes market research**: thousands of AI voice interviews, emotion signals, traceable clips, and customer simulation turn “ask users” from slow theater into live product radar.

**智能体开始吞掉工作流**：Codex 走出开发者圈，Claude Code 加上 workflows，Gemini 把 Thinking Levels 放到全端；**no-code 被 yes-code 反杀**：Vercel、Replit、OpenClaw 都在抢“让智能体写完就能上线”的底座；**Listen Labs 把用户调研改成雷达**：AI 同时跑上千个语音访谈，看表情、留证据、回连销售数据，比问卷狠多了。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-02
dates.summary:
**DeepMind’s origin story gets sharper**: Demis Hassabis moves from one-lab AGI dreams to government-enforced safety; **agent workflows keep getting real**: builders trade worktrees, cross-model reviews, voice prompts, and Codex swarms; **model distribution heats up**: OpenAI-on-AWS chatter, MiniMax M3’s agent benchmark claim, and enterprise data moats dominate the feed.

**DeepMind 的旧账被翻出来了**：Demis 从“一个实验室搞定 AGI”走到“得靠政府定规矩”；**AI agent 不再只是口号**：worktree、交叉审查、语音提示、Codex 常驻跑任务，全是实操味；**模型入口开始抢人**：AWS、MiniMax M3、企业数据护城河一起冒头，热闹但不空泛。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-05-31
dates.summary:
English: Today’s snapshot covers **Claude Managed Agents** adding dreaming, outcomes, orchestration, and webhooks; **Gemini** co-lead Oriol Vinyals on world models, multimodal learning, RL, memory, and robotics; plus builder posts on **Codex**, **GPT-5.5**, **Vercel AI Gateway**, **Cursor** auto-review, AI education, enterprise AI investment, and California politics.

中文：今天的快照包括 **Claude Managed Agents** 新增 dreaming、outcomes、多智能体编排和 webhooks；**Gemini** 联合负责人 Oriol Vinyals 谈世界模型、多模态学习、RL、记忆和机器人；以及关于 **Codex**、**GPT-5.5**、**Vercel AI Gateway**、**Cursor** auto-review、AI 教育、企业 AI 投入和加州政治的 builder 动态。
